snapshot.h2: What working with us looks like in Coral Gables

facts.label: Filming
facts.value: In person, by our own crew

paragraphsHtml: Coral Gables is part of our South Florida home base, so shoots happen at your restaurant with our own crew. We plan each shoot with you, and one shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content. After that, we post it and manage your pages.

Our nearby client is Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse in Pinecrest, a coffee shop and art space known for its creative lattes. We make short videos with the team there: we pitch, they pitch, and the strongest ideas make the feed. The clip at the top of this page is from one of those videos, which has 7.4M views. You can see more on our Kendall and Pinecrest page.

proof.h2: Short videos for Brewing Buddha in Pinecrest
proof.bodyHtml: Our short videos about Brewing Buddha's lattes and its staff have reached 24M+ views on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook. One skit about a party-size Cookie Butter Latte order drew 7.4M views on its own.

steps.h2: How we'd start with your Coral Gables restaurant

items.title: A 30-minute call with Juan
items.bodyHtml: On the call, Juan, our co-founder, goes through your Google Business Profile, website and social pages and tells you what he'd work on first. It's free.

items.title: Your first shoot day
items.bodyHtml: Our crew films at your restaurant on a day you choose, and we edit the footage into posts for your social media.

items.title: Ongoing posting and Google updates
items.bodyHtml: We post and manage your pages, keep your Google Business Profile up to date as part of our restaurant SEO and AEO service, and send you a monthly report.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Coral Gables?
faqs.a: Yes. We're headquartered in Miami, and our crew works with Coral Gables restaurants in person. Our nearby client is Brewing Buddha on SW 124th St in Pinecrest.

faqs.q: Will your team come to my restaurant to film?
faqs.a: Yes. Coral Gables is in South Florida, our home base, so our own crew does the filming at your restaurant. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content.

faqs.q: Do you create content in Spanish?
faqs.a: Yes. We work in English and Spanish, so posts and captions can be in either language or both, and every website page we build comes in both.

faqs.q: We have another location outside South Florida. Can you cover it?
faqs.a: Yes. Ads, websites, and SEO and AEO are done remotely, so they work anywhere in the US. For social media, our Miami team plans and manages the content, and a videographer or photographer from our network in that area does the shoot.

cta.h2: Let's talk about your Coral Gables restaurant
cta.body: On a free 30-minute call, Juan will go over how your restaurant shows up online today and tell you what he would fix first. The call can be in English or Spanish.
